FactionDef.label: Arasaka
FactionDef.description: A Japanese megacorporation: security, banking and military hardware. Its private army is one of the best equipped in the world.

FactionDef.label: Militech
FactionDef.description: The largest arms manufacturer in the world, and Arasaka's fiercest rival. Militech fields soldiers, drones and heavy weapons.

FactionDef.label: Kang Tao
FactionDef.description: A fast-growing Chinese arms maker known for smart weapons.

FactionDef.label: Biotechnica
FactionDef.description: A biotech giant that controls much of the world's food supply.

FactionDef.label: Petrochem
FactionDef.description: An energy and agriculture corporation with private security to protect its fields and refineries.

FactionDef.label: Zetatech
FactionDef.description: A cyberware and electronics corporation.

FactionDef.label: Night Corp
FactionDef.description: A secretive corporation with a hand in city infrastructure.

FactionDef.label: NetWatch
FactionDef.description: The net police. NetWatch hunts rogue AIs and netrunners who push too far.

FactionDef.label: Trauma Team International
FactionDef.description: A paramedic company with an armed response. Pay for coverage and a Trauma Team squad will come for you when you go down.

FactionDef.label: MaxTac
FactionDef.description: NCPD Maximum Force Tactical Division. When a cyberpsycho starts piling up bodies, MaxTac drops in to put them down. They are chromed to the limit and immune to cyberpsychosis.

FactionDef.label: Militech Receivables
FactionDef.description: A collection agency that buys unpaid medical debt from Trauma Team. When the bill comes due, they come to collect: in silver, in chrome, or in blood.

FactionDef.label: Maelstrom
FactionDef.description: A gang obsessed with chrome, more machine than human. Most of them live one bad day away from cyberpsychosis.

FactionDef.label: Tyger Claws
FactionDef.description: A gang with deep roots in organised crime. They favour katanas and sandevistans.

FactionDef.label: Valentinos
FactionDef.description: A neighbourhood gang bound by family, honour and gold. Pistols and revolvers.

FactionDef.label: 6th Street
FactionDef.description: Veterans turned gangers who run their turf like an army unit. Power rifles, little chrome.

FactionDef.label: Animals
FactionDef.description: Bodybuilders on combat stims and muscle grafts. They fight with fists, gorilla arms and berserk, never with guns.

FactionDef.label: Voodoo Boys
FactionDef.description: A gang of netrunners. Expect cyberdecks and quickhacks.

FactionDef.label: Mox
FactionDef.description: A gang that protects the people nobody else will. They trade and keep to themselves unless provoked.

FactionDef.label: Scavengers
FactionDef.description: Scavs: organ harvesters and cyberware thieves who run on scrap gear.

FactionDef.label: Wraiths
FactionDef.description: Badlands raiders in patched-together gear.

FactionDef.label: Barghest
FactionDef.description: A paramilitary force with military-grade gear and discipline to match.

FactionDef.label: Aldecaldos
FactionDef.description: A nomad clan: family, the road and the deal, in that order.

FactionDef.label: Raffen Shiv
FactionDef.description: A nomad clan that turned raider. They trade when it suits them and fight when it doesn't.
